Name: Random Hair Color
Author: bookworm89723
Description:
It changes your hair. Specifically it generates 3 random values and uses them as RGB values for your hair color that day. 

Source code for the project can be found [url=https://github.com/joaniedavis/RandomHairMod/tree/master/RandomHairColorMod]here[/url].

Downloads.Description: This is the mod collection. Unzip it and add it to your mod directory.
